tracks.name: Script VM / Event
tracks.evidence: 2026-09-26: CA:C000 real script-pack indices 0x14..0xF9 are crosswalked to the same-index C7:0000 source families. A4 operand is confirmed as source subindex; 2,202 decoder-reachable high-confidence A4 source pairs were enumerated. Family 0x50 selections 0x11 and 0x12 are now bounded as distinct enclosing records at CC:1DFE..1E0F and CC:1E0F..1E2F. 2026-09-26 ROM-wide frame scan: 947 valid 7A/body/7C-next trailers yielded 816 B0-anchored structural records across 107 families; 713 records crosslink to validated source selections.

Exact token-hash crosslink to retained v33 decodes identifies 21 current dialogue pairs, including 19 previously visibility-unknown pairs in families 0x4E/0x4F/0x50. Effective unresolved visibility is 2,206; complete rendered-corpus coverage is not claimed.

top_goals.name: 全イベント完全解析

top_goals.evidence: ROM-wide structural framing now anchors 816 B0-start records across 107 families. Crosslinking only source-reader-validated A4 selections maps 1,124 callsites into 713 records across 98 families. This materially advances event inventory and script-to-resource linkage, while conditions/actions/runtime completeness remain incomplete.

top_goals.name: 別環境で再構築可能な完全仕様書

top_goals.evidence: FastROM HiROM addressing, overlapping source-family model, script-pack/source-family crosswalk and deterministic usage catalog are portable and reproducible. Full subsystem coverage and independent verification remain incomplete. Event-record framing and event-to-source linkage are now reproducibly externalized as tools plus metadata summaries.
